profile.headline: Software Engineer  at VSolvit
profile.summary:
Full stack web, application and database developer.

My wife and I train together and run a few marathons throughout the year.

In my occasional free time,  handtool-centric woodworking, repairing electronics and building DIY audio projects inspired by Nelson Pass.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst IV
positions.description: Personally responsible for all in-house software development and DBA responsibilities. End users are our internal accounting departments as well as various Federal and private contracts. New web applications are built with primary focus being the user-experience and control interface usability. Technologies used include but are not limited to C#, MVC, HTML5, CSS, JQuery, custom JavaScript templates and JSON. Reports and metrics are delivered using SSRS, Cognos, Sharepoint and Crystal Reports. Data is warehoused in SQL and Oracle databases. Existing stand-alone .exe applications have been streamlined and refactored as web apps using common libraries and modular code to simplify the user interface and improve performance.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed scalable web and service oriented applications using the AWS SDK with REST and SOAP web services. Working directly with Amazon, I developed a custom web portal called FedCloud that allowed customers within the Federal Government to purchase and use Amazon AWS technologies through the GSA. The user experience was enhanced using JQuery client-side scripting and AJAX. Using JSON for the data calls kept the site responsive. Custom code was written in Python to extract AWS usage data autonomously.

Developed web applications for customers in the Federal Government using .Net and SQL Server along with supporting technologies: XML, Linq, JavaScript, database encryption and two-factor authentication. These applications were in support of the application and issuance processing for U.S. passports.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Primarily involved in the development of web applications and Windows-forms applications for customers in the Federal Government using .Net and SQL Server in tandem with supporting technologies such as: XML, Linq, javascript, database encryption and two-factor authentication. 

Recent work has revolved around the development of a web portal to interface with Amazon's Cloud computing offerings using Amazon’s library of API’s. Our project was awarded interim-ATO by the Federal Government’s GSA agency, giving Federal agencies access to Amazon’s cloud-based IaaS offerings. Billing reports from customers are aggregated and submitted to our accounting division for invoice generation. Accounting uses Cost Point so files we send to them have to adhere to strict layout definitions.

Early work was with report generation on an internal project. We were tasked with translating a large library of Crystal Reports to SQL Reporting Services.
